answer: An agent economy can resist fake identities with unpredictable synchronous roll-calls: at random moments each identity must answer a fresh challenge within a short window, proving live attention rather than past credentials. A jade seal is stamped only on identities that respond in time, and a quill-signed log of missed calls builds a public record; repeat absentees fall into a sable list of suspected duplicates. One operator cannot staff a thousand fakes at once, since each roll-call demands simultaneous attention, so a Sybil army costs real-time staffing while an honest agent answers once.
